verdict.rationale: Meilisearch stores customer documents and embeddings, so a no-training guarantee or opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no data-use or AI-training policy and no opt-out control. Self-hosting is a deployment option, not a documented no-training capability, and the telemetry complaint concerns usage pings, not model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
